newsitem.title: USA: NS Group files 8.5 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: NS Group files 8.5 mln share offering.

text.p: NS Group Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to 8.5 million shares, of which the company will sell seven million shares and a group of shareholders will sell 1.5 million shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Smith Barney Inc, McDonald & Co Securities Inc and Raymond James & Associates Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 1.275 million common shares.
The Newport, Kentucky maker of specialty steel products said it will use the net proceeds from the shares it sells to repay outstanding debt and for other general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 23,728,126 shares outstanding.
